description: Backend project scaffold, env-driven settings with offline SQLite fallback, Vercel entry/deploy config, and apps/accounts (custom User + Role + single-sourced pure RBAC helpers with view and DRF adapters). This is the foundation every later FEAT builds on; the custom User must exist before any migration, so accounts ships with the scaffold. Depends on nothing.
steps: Create manage.py, requirements.txt (exact == pins: Django==5.1.4, djangorestframework==3.15.2, django-environ==0.11.2, psycopg[binary]==3.2.3, whitenoise==6.8.2, argon2-cffi==23.1.0, django-components==0.100; NO gunicorn, NO requests), .python-version (3.13), .gitignore (ignore .env, db.sqlite3, __pycache__, staticfiles/, node_modules/, static/dist/), and .env.example (the eight AGENTS.md names ONLY with dummy/empty RHS: SECRET_KEY, DEBUG, ALLOWED_HOSTS, DATABASE_URL, SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_KEY, PAYMONGO_SECRET_KEY, PAYMONGO_WEBHOOK_SECRET; add a DATABASE_URL comment naming the transaction-mode pooler port 6543 vs direct 5432, and an ALLOWED_HOSTS comment to include your-app.vercel.app and custom domains).
Create apps/__init__.py (makes apps/ a package) and the profit/ project package: __init__.py, settings.py, urls.py, wsgi.py, asgi.py.

In profit/settings.py implement, per the Revision 4 appendix and AGENTS.md: django-environ reads with environ.Env.read_env; DATABASES['default'] = env.db_url('DATABASE_URL', default=f"sqlite:///{BASE_DIR / 'db.sqlite3'}"); set DISABLE_SERVER_SIDE_CURSORS=True and CONN_MAX_AGE=0 UNCONDITIONALLY on DATABASES['default']; an advisory-only startup WARNING when DEBUG=False and the parsed port is 5432 (normalize empty port to the scheme default; log only the port, never host/user/credentials). ALLOWED_HOSTS from CSV env: when DEBUG=True fall back to ['localhost','127.0.0.1']; when DEBUG=False and ALLOWED_HOSTS is unset/empty raise django.core.exceptions.ImproperlyConfigured at startup (do NOT silently fall back to localhost); optionally seed from VERCEL_URL when present. AUTH_USER_MODEL='accounts.User'. TIME_ZONE='Asia/Manila', USE_TZ=True, LANGUAGE_CODE='en-us'. WhiteNoise middleware immediately after SecurityMiddleware; STATIC_URL='static/', STATIC_ROOT=BASE_DIR/'staticfiles', STATICFILES_DIRS=[BASE_DIR/'static'/'dist', BASE_DIR/'static'/'vendor'], STORAGES static backend = whitenoise CompressedManifestStaticFilesStorage. DEBUG-gated security: SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT, SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE, CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE, SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS, SECURE_PROXY_SSL_HEADER=('HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO','https') on when DEBUG=False, relaxed when True. SECRET_KEY from env with the dev-insecure fallback literal. REST_FRAMEWORK: DEFAULT_AUTHENTICATION_CLASSES=['rest_framework.authentication.SessionAuthentication'], DEFAULT_PERMISSION_CLASSES=['rest_framework.permissions.IsAuthenticated']. LOGGING console config with a module docstring/comment restating 'never log PII or payment details'. django-components wiring: 'django_components' in INSTALLED_APPS, django_components.template_loader.Loader in TEMPLATES[0]['OPTIONS']['loaders'] (and APP_DIRS handled accordingly), COMPONENTS={'dirs':[BASE_DIR/'components']}. INSTALLED_APPS includes django.contrib defaults, rest_framework, django_components, and apps.accounts (dotted). PASSWORD_HASHERS left at Django default (Argon2 first) with argon2-cffi installed.

Create api/index.py exposing `from profit.wsgi import application as app`, and vercel.json pinning functions.'api/index.py'.runtime='python3.13', buildCommand 'npm --prefix static/src install && npm --prefix static/src run build && python manage.py collectstatic --noinput', functions.'api/index.py'.includeFiles globs (staticfiles/**, static/dist/**, static/vendor/**, templates/**, components/**), and a rewrites rule routing '/(.*)' to '/api/index'. Add a one-line comment/doc (NIT-3) that WhiteNoise-inside-function static serving is a deliberate first-build choice, CDN optimization deferred.

Create apps/accounts: __init__.py, apps.py (AppConfig name='apps.accounts', label='accounts'), models.py with Role(models.TextChoices) OWNER/CASHIER/TRAINER/MEMBER and User(AbstractUser) with role = CharField(max_length=20, choices=Role.choices, default=Role.MEMBER), admin.py registering User.

Create apps/accounts/permissions.py with PURE functions (NO request/DRF imports): can_view_financials(user) (Owner only); can_initiate_payment(user, member=None) (Owner/Cashier for anyone, Member for self; intent only, NEVER writes status); can_manage_enrollment(user) (Owner, Cashier); can_view_attendance(user, member=None) (Owner/Cashier/Trainer for anyone, Member own only); can_edit_own_profile(user, target_user) (returns target_user == user for ALL roles). Every helper returns False for an anonymous/None user. These encode the AGENTS.md matrix EXACTLY and must not add any capability beyond it (no staff-edits-others).

Create apps/accounts/adapters.py with the two thin adapters that delegate to permissions.py: a role_required(checker) Django-view decorator/mixin that raises PermissionDenied (403) for an authenticated wrong-role user and redirects an anonymous user to LOGIN_URL; and DRF BasePermission subclasses CanViewFinancials, CanManageEnrollment, CanViewAttendance whose has_permission/has_object_permission call the matching pure helper. Adapters own HTTP translation only; permissions.py owns policy.
Generate the fresh initial migration for accounts (python manage.py makemigrations accounts) with the custom user baked in.
acceptance_criteria: In a Python 3.13 venv with requirements installed, `python manage.py check` exits 0 with DATABASE_URL unset (SQLite default in use).
`python manage.py makemigrations accounts` produces exactly one initial migration and `python manage.py migrate` applies cleanly on SQLite.
`python -c "from api.index import app"` succeeds inside the venv (the Vercel WSGI symbol imports).
Setting DEBUG=False with ALLOWED_HOSTS unset makes startup raise ImproperlyConfigured (fail fast), while DEBUG=True runs with the localhost fallback.
requirements.txt contains only exact == pins and no gunicorn and no requests.
verification: Run `python manage.py check` and confirm it exits 0.
Run `python manage.py makemigrations accounts` then `python manage.py migrate` and confirm both succeed.
Run `python -c "from api.index import app"` and confirm no import error.
Append the real command output to .agents/tasks/profit-scaffold/verification.md.
findings: Scaffold verified on Python 3.13.14 offline (SQLite default): check=0, makemigrations accounts -> single 0001_initial (Create model User), migrate=0, `from api.index import app`=0, and DEBUG=False+unset ALLOWED_HOSTS raises ImproperlyConfigured at startup. Notes for later FEATs: (1) AUTH_USER_MODEL='accounts.User' is baked into accounts.0001_initial; User(AbstractUser) adds `role` (Role TextChoices OWNER/CASHIER/TRAINER/MEMBER, default MEMBER) -- do NOT edit the applied migration, add new ones. (2) django-components==0.100 wiring confirmed against the installed package: loader is `django_components.template_loader.Loader`; COMPONENTS uses the lowercase `dirs` key; AUTODISCOVER was set to False in COMPONENTS because the local .venv lives under BASE_DIR and the autodiscover tree-walk otherwise tries to import `.venv/.../django_components/components/dynamic` and crashes at startup -- a later FEAT adding real components should register them via the loader (or set a scoped autodiscover) rather than flipping autodiscover back on blindly. (3) TEMPLATES[0] uses an explicit `loaders` list (filesystem, app_directories, django_components) so APP_DIRS is omitted (cannot set both). (4) RBAC is single-sourced in apps/accounts/permissions.py as pure functions (anonymous/None -> False); HTTP translation is in apps/accounts/adapters.py: role_required(checker) view decorator (redirect_to_login for anon, PermissionDenied/403 for wrong role) and DRF BasePermission subclasses CanViewFinancials/CanManageEnrollment/CanViewAttendance. can_initiate_payment/can_view_attendance expect the target to expose `user_id` (so MemberProfile in membership should keep its OneToOneField(User) accessible as `.user`). (5) DB flags DISABLE_SERVER_SIDE_CURSORS=True and CONN_MAX_AGE=0 are set unconditionally on DATABASES['default']; the 5432-vs-6543 guard is advisory WARNING only and only fires when DEBUG=False and ENGINE is postgresql. (6) STATICFILES_DIRS point at static/dist and static/vendor (placeholder .gitkeep dirs created; dist is gitignored); STORAGES staticfiles backend is whitenoise CompressedManifestStaticFilesStorage which needs collectstatic output at request time (handled by the Vercel buildCommand + includeFiles in vercel.json). (7) requirements.txt is exact == pins only, no gunicorn, no requests. (8) vercel.json includeFiles is a comma-joined glob string (staticfiles/**,static/dist/**,static/vendor/**,templates/**,components/**).
